description:
Start a generation in the background and return a job_id at once. Use it for any plain-English
    `request` (a model designs the tables, which takes minutes) — then call get_status(job_id) every
    20-30 seconds until it says done, or pass `webhook_url` to be told. Arguments are the same as
    generate_dataset, `name`, `webhook_url` and `as_of` included.

    Returns:
        job_id, status "running". get_status gives the stage and, when finished, the dataset.
name: start_generation
title: Start a generation (background)
